visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men sit behind a wooden table in a brightly lit room; the man in the center wears a brown shirt and has long wavy hair, while his companions in grey sweaters and caps smile and listen. (2) The center man holds a circular wooden container to the camera, revealing a wedge of cheese topped with a thick layer of white, fuzzy mold. (3) The man on the left leans in to smell the cheese and immediately recoils with a disgusted facial expression, causing the center man to laugh while holding the box. (4) A close-up shot shows hands using a small knife to scoop out the moldy surface, then pouring clear white wine from a bottle into the cheese container over rosemary sprigs and garlic. (5) The tray is placed into a stainless steel oven; a subsequent shot shows the cheese melted and bubbling, surrounded by roasted potatoes, sausages, and tomatoes. (6) The men use forks to dip pieces of bread and sausages into the melted cheese, pulling long, gooey strands into the air before eating. (7) The center man eats a large spoonful of the melted cheese, closing his eyes with a satisfied expression while his friends continue to taste and discuss the dish. (8) The group sits together at the table, laughing and gesturing toward the half-eaten tray of roasted food and melted cheese.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar track accompanied by an energetic male voice speaking with high pitch and dynamic intonation. (2) A subtle whoosh sound effect punctuates a transition as the speaker introduces the cheese, followed by background group laughter. (3) The acoustic guitar continues as the sound of a liquid being poured from a bottle into a container is clearly audible, with high spectral clarity. (4) A sharp mechanical click and the low hum of an oven fan signal the cooking phase, with the music maintaining a steady tempo throughout. (5) As the food is eaten, the sounds of moist chewing and occasional fork-on-plate clinks are layered beneath excited dialogue and high-arousal exclamations. (6) The final phase features consistent speech-music overlap as the three men laugh and converse in a lively, friendly tone, with the guitar music fading at the very end.
